name: url_analyzer
description: Analyze a URL for phishing/scam red flags before the user clicks it: follows redirects to reveal the real destination (defeats link shorteners), and checks for IP-literal hosts, punycode/homoglyph domains, credential-in-URL tricks (user@evil.com), suspicious TLDs, excessive subdomains, and lookalike brand names. Optionally cross-checks the final URL against VirusTotal if VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY is set. Use this whenever a user shares a link and asks 'is this safe' or before summarizing/opening a link from an unknown sender.
